channel.description: JC3 Malaysia official news and updates

item.title: The JC3 remains committed to advancing the climate agenda through coordinated and collaborative efforts
item.description: The Climate Finance Innovation Lab (CFIL) launched on 18 June 2025 aims to serve as a collaborative platform to identify, develop and accelerate innovative climate solutions and mechanisms that can mobilise private and public finance to support Malaysia’s transition to net zero.

item.title: Joint Statement by Bank Negara Malaysia and Securities Commission Malaysia on the Rollout of the Climate Finance Innovation Lab
item.description: Climate change poses real risks to the economy and financial system. In response to the increasing threats of climate change, the JC3 was established in September 2019 as a regulator-industry platform, aiming to pursue collaborative actions for building climate resilience within the Malaysia financial sector.

item.title: Publication of ‘Building Supply Chain Resilience: Insights into Greening Value Chains for ASEAN’ Playbook
item.description: The adoption of sustainable, green and low-carbon practices will help SMEs future proof business plans, retain market access and gain a competitive advantage as Malaysia and the world transition to a net zero and sustainable future.

item.title: Joint Statement by Bank Negara Malaysia and Securities Commission Malaysia on the 14th Joint Committee on Climate Change (JC3) Meeting
item.description: Embracing sustainability is not only ethically responsible but also makes good business sense for SMEs. It can lead to improved financial performance, enhanced reputation, and a positive impact on the planet and society.
